questions: Does the fixed island-equal temporal-minus-within-phase Sørensen excess remain positive in both guilds on all seven islands?
Which fraction of original island-average across-period Sørensen dissimilarity is also observed from same-campaign half-splits, without misnaming it explained detection bias?
Are island-level per-transect supports sufficient to distinguish a 7-island descriptive statement from pseudo-replicated trap and split counts?
Does the previously fixed canopy-beating Beetle secondary STOP remain respected?

estimands.main: B1/B3 across-period matched-effort half-sample Sørensen dissimilarity MINUS source-period split-half Sørensen non-similarity, averaged within physical transect, then original island equally weighted.
estimands.secondary: Same decomposition for Simpson replacement; report separate physical-site signs and per-island means, not a new significance test.
estimands.relative_context: within_period_mean / across_period_mean, a ratio of descriptive non-similarity means, NOT fraction of real turnover explained by detection.
estimands.guild_comparison: Original island-level excess contrast Beetle−Spider in each of 7 islands as descriptive only; both share sites/source and are not independent ecological experiments.
estimands.baseline: Original 2024 BALA authors' broad abundance/biomass/richness stability is PRIOR ART, not newly discovered.

stop: Original source SHA, source artifact JSON SHA or 29/7 physical site design mismatch
Source group counts do not add up to original admitted sites, or 7-island mean differs from original float to >1e-12
Any negative source island value is suppressed or imputed
Original source-free secondary beating beetle STOP changed to positive
conclusion_boundary: Temporal signal beyond within-period sampling heterogeneity is observed. It does NOT prove environmental cause, true local extinction/colonization, demographic rescue, perfect detection correction or replication beyond one archipelago.
